name: aurabot-v1
description: Aura is a locally-run, privacy-focused AI companion designed to be a supportive partner for mental wellness and personal productivity. Built with a focus on proactive assistance, Aura doesn't just answer questions—it anticipates your needs and provides interactive tools to help you organize your thoughts, manage stress, and stay motivated.
